Module org.apache.jena.core
Package org.apache.jena.mem.store.indexed

Class IndexList

java.lang.Object
org.apache.jena.mem.store.indexed.IndexList
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.jena.atlas.lib.Copyable<IndexList>
public class IndexList extends Object implements org.apache.jena.atlas.lib.Copyable<IndexList>
Append-only list of int triple indices, used by the eager indexing strategy as the value type of the per-node index lists ("for the subject node N, here are the indices of all triples whose subject is N").

Backed by an int array that grows by factor 1.5. Removal is constant-time swap-with-last so callers must keep an external reverse-index array in sync (see EagerStoreStrategy).

      public int[] getIndices()
      Returns the underlying int array. Only the first size() entries are valid. Exposed as a raw array to allow callers (e.g. iterators and intersection routines) to avoid bounds-checked accessors in tight loops.

    • removeAt

      public int removeAt(int position)
      Remove the index at the given position by swapping the last element into its place ("swap-with-last"). The caller is responsible for updating any external reverse-index that points at the moved element.
      Parameters:
      position - the position of the index to remove
      Returns:
      the triple index of the element that was moved into position (so the caller can update its reverse index), or -1 if the removed element was the last one and nothing was moved

    • intersects

      public static boolean intersects(IndexList a, int[] reverseIndicesA, IndexList b, int[] reverseIndicesB)
      Test whether two index lists share at least one common triple index. The lists are not assumed to be sorted; this implementation iterates the shorter list and checks each entry against the larger list using the larger list's reverse-index array, giving O(min(|a|,|b|)).
      Parameters:
      a - first list
      reverseIndicesA - reverse index for a: maps a triple index to its position in a.getIndices()
      b - second list
      reverseIndicesB - reverse index for b
      Returns:
      true if a and b share any element
